name: Fontin - Grandalen
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage through Kungalv municipality, from Fontin/Kotten recreation area to Grandalen at the Svartedalen boundary; no official alternate geometry found, but several access and side-trip points exist

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 7. Fontin - Grandalen
keyFacts: Canonical current name is Fontin - Grandalen.
Official WST slug is 7-fontin-grandalen.
Official distance is 16 km / 16000 m.
Official estimated time is 6-7 h.
Official difficulty is blue / medium.
Stage runs through Kungalv municipality from Fontin to Grandalen.
Route starts by Svarte Mosse in Fontin, passes broadleaf woodland, forested plateaus, gravel roads, farmland, forest and some built-up areas.
About two-thirds along, the route reaches Romesjon, with swimming, picnic/rest area and tenting mentioned by WST.
North of Romesjon the route becomes denser and more coniferous, passes Dalen, and ends at Grandalen on the boundary of Svartedalen.
WST describes the stage as relatively easy but long, and hillier toward the end.
Surface is mainly gravel/dirt road and forest path.

normalizationNotes: Preserve WST official distance 16 km and computed official geometry length 16.413 km separately.
Use official WST endpoint [57.873497, 11.999800] for Fontin start and [57.962139, 12.007714] for Grandalen end.
De-duplicate WST/Hoodin GPX repeated coordinates before geometry processing.
Do not use OSM relation 125205 as primary geometry; its 19 km distance tag appears stale and endpoints differ from official endpoints.
Surface Avverkning Romelanda as active trail-status/currentness metadata unless WST removes it before publication.
Suppress stale Bohusbron status for Stage 7 unless a current official source republishes it.
Cluster Fontin/Kotten facilities to avoid duplicate service records.
Import Romesjon as a local tent/rest/swim cluster with high-water and bathing-season caveats; do not generalize camping permission.
Do not mark Dalen water as guaranteed potable until manager/on-site verification.
Flag Aleklatten and Karleksstigen as detour/near-route if imported; flag Dyröds gard, Diserod services and Nordiska/Kungalv town services as off-route/nearby-service metadata.
Treat Vasttrafik timetables, commercial/service hours, fire bans, bathing water and forestry notices as volatile.
